title: Lego Black Friday deals 2026 UK: what's a good price?
description: The best Lego deals in the UK right now, what Lego's Black Friday discounts looked like last year, and which sets are retiring before Christmas.
intro:

We update this page as prices move. These prices were checked on 19 and 20 October 2026.

body:
## What counts as a good Lego price?

Lego rarely goes below about 30% off on popular sets, so use these rough rules:

- **20% off:** fair, but not special.
- **25–30% off:** a good price, roughly what Lego.com offered on Star Wars, Technic, Icons and Ideas sets at Black Friday 2025.
- **40% off or more:** usually only on older or less popular sets, often ones about to retire.

Which? suggests another check: price per brick. Around 10p a piece is typical. Licensed sets (Star Wars, Harry Potter, Marvel) often cost 11–12p, while Lego's own themes like City and Friends are nearer 7–8p.

For price history, Brickfact and Bricksleuth compare UK retailers, PriceSpy shows a three-month history, and the Keepa or CamelCamelCamel browser extensions show Amazon's.

## When do Lego Black Friday deals start?

Black Friday 2026 is on **Friday 27 November**. Lego's own **Insiders Weekend is on 21–22 November**, and last year that brought double Insiders points (worth about 10% back) and free gifts with bigger orders. Lego.com's main Black Friday sale is expected to run around 27–30 November, though Lego hasn't confirmed it yet.

Amazon, John Lewis, Very and Argos tend to cut prices earlier and often beat Lego.com on the headline price. Lego.com wins when you want the free gift or points, so add those into the sums on bigger orders.

## Which Lego sets are retiring in 2026?

Lego retires sets in two waves, with the big one at the end of December. Once a set is retired, prices usually go up, not down. Sets reported to be retiring at the end of 2026 include:

- Star Wars UCS Millennium Falcon (75192), Jabba's Sail Barge (75397) and Rebel U-wing (75399)
- Technic Porsche GT4 e-Performance (42176)
- Icons Natural History Museum (10326)
- Botanicals Poinsettia (10370) and Flower Arrangement (10345)
- Harry Potter Hogwarts Castle: Flying Lessons (76447) and The Burrow Collectors' Edition (76437)
- City Police Station (60316)

Lego doesn't publish exact dates and stock can run out early, so if one of these is on your list, buy it when you see a fair price.

### Is it worth waiting for Black Friday for Lego?

Only if the set isn't discounted yet. Many popular sets are already 25–30% off, which is about as low as they went last year, and the best-selling ones can go out of stock in December.

### Where is Lego cheapest in the UK?

Amazon is often cheapest on big sets, but John Lewis, Very, Argos, Sainsbury's and Smyths all undercut it from time to time. Use a price comparison site before buying.

### Is Lego.com ever the cheapest?

Rarely on price alone, but its Black Friday free gifts and double Insiders points can make it the best value on a large order.

### When should I buy Lego advent calendars?

Now. They're already below RRP and they sell out before December rather than getting cheaper.
